16 MiB = 16 × 1,048,576 = 16,777,216 bytes. The policy specifies MiB (binary), not MB (decimal). If someone read 16 MB as 16,000,000 bytes, the at-byte-limit case (16,777,216) would wrongly be rejected.

| over-file-limit | 513 | 10,000 | 513 > 512 → fail | pass | **Rejected** (file count) |
